تحتشون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَشُونَ (taḥtašūna) /taħ.ta.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# تُحْتَشَوْنَ (tuḥtašawna) /tuħ.ta.ʃaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
